preconditions.description: The number of rows in the board is between 1 and 15, inclusive.
The number of columns in the board is between 1 and 15, inclusive.
The minimum number of distinct positive numbers in the connected block is between 1 and 7, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All elements in the board are in [-1, n*m]
preconditions.description: The numbers on the board are between -1 and the total number of entries, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All elements in the cost matrix are in [1, 100000]
preconditions.description: The cost of selecting each entry is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: There are at least K distinct positive numbers in the board
preconditions.description: The board contains at least K distinct positive numbers that are not -1.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no valid block can be found, or a non-negative integer representing the minimum total cost of selecting a connected block with at least K distinct positive numbers.
